description: This is a PHP web page source file responsible for rendering and handling the logic of a 'Change Password' webpage in a web application. It includes HTML, JavaScript, and PHP code to display a form for changing user passwords, perform client-side validation, and interact with server-side scripts to update passwords.

methods.name: getInstanceNum
methods.description: Determines the user instance number based on the current username stored in session, used for password change logic.

methods.name: cancel_save
methods.description: Redirects the user to the 'at_a_glance.php' page when canceling the password change.

methods.name: set_config
methods.description: Sends an AJAX request to save the new password configuration and provides user feedback.

methods.name: next_step
methods.description: Validates input passwords and initiates password change process by calling set_config.
